decisions.checklists: All 220 original 2005 Ultra base cards cross-matched number/player/team in BCP and independent MCB. BCP + MCB checked for all four numbered original insert groups and original memorabilia variants.
decisions.trueRookies: No 2005 Ultra All-Rookie (#201-220) is a true RC per BaseballCardPedia; no blanket rookie flags.
decisions.sourceAliases: Original source differences: #53 Alexis/Alex Rios; #137 Ichiro Suzuki/Ichiro. Follow the Leader #9 Ichiro Suzuki/Ichiro. Season Crowns Platinum autograph #149 BCP misspells 'Albett Pujols'; independent source and base card confirm Albert Pujols.
decisions.followLeaderJerseys: BCP 14 real Follow the Leader jersey subjects, MCB 15 includes extra FLJ-MP Mike Piazza duplicating authentic FLJ-MPI; source-verified 14 Copper/Red/Gold/Platinum/UltraSwatch groups only.
decisions.kingsJerseys: BCP 45 genuine Kings jersey codes; source typos UKI-MTX (corrected UKJ-MTX), second UKJ-SC Scott Rolen (corrected UKJ-SR); independent MCB crosschecks. MCB Ultra Kings Jersey includes 7 extra code aliases, not additional authentic physical cards. Gold UltraSwatch 45 independently identified as 30 Ultra Kings + 15 Strikeout Kings sub-checklists and issued as UKJU- codes.
decisions.goldKings: Authentic 45 Ultra Kings Gold /50, original physical 1 UK to 45 UK, published order SK 1-15, RBI 16-30, HR 31-45.
decisions.memories: Season Crowns 50 game-used Copper /399, Gold /99, Platinum Patch /25; autographs Copper 5, Gold 14, Platinum 34 with authentic per-card cap from BCP, and Platinum Masterpiece 34 one-of-ones. Follow Leader Jersey five materials; Kings Jersey three, triple jersey 10 /33.
decisions.formats: 2005 Ultra one original series: Hobby 8 cards x24 packs and Retail 8 cards x24 packs. Hobby Gold one per pack, retail Gold 1:3, All-Rookie SP hobby 1:4 retail 1:5. Other subset-specific odds, memorabilia format, serial caps incompatible with simple integer group odds.
decisions.release: Unreleased VCS draft until original pack image, genuine card scans, pricing and appropriate pack-slot/collation review. All oddsPerPack null; previous products remain untouched.
